sessions.level: Our Vinyasa classes focus on a flowing sequence of poses, synchronising breath with movement to build strength, flexibility, and balance. These classes are perfect for those looking to energise and invigorate their body and mind. Each session is a journey, encouraging mindfulness and self-exploration.

Our Yin Yoga classes offer a more meditative approach, with a focus on long-held, passive stretches to target deep connective tissues. This practice is ideal for those seeking to release tension, enhance joint mobility, and cultivate a deeper sense of inner calm

Experience the traditional essence of Pilates with Pando Pilates. 

This foundational practice emphasises controlled movements, core strength, and flexibility, helping you develop a deep mind-body connection. 

Perfect for all levels, it's designed to enhance posture, balance, and overall well-being.

Get your heart pumping with Pando Sweat, a high-intensity Pilates session that pushes your limits.

Perfect for those looking to amp up their fitness game!

Experience the restorative power of deep relaxation in a breathwork class designed to gently activate your parasympathetic nervous system, guiding you into a state of profound calm and inner balance.

This journey promotes deep relaxation and introspection, allowing you to tap into greater insights, heightened emotional awareness, and enhanced mental clarity. As you sink into this tranquil state, you’ll connect more deeply with your inner self, fostering a sense of inner peace and self-compassion.

By incorporating this practice into your routine, you'll experience tangible benefits such as a strengthened immune system, reduced stress and inflammation, improved focus and mental clarity, increased energy, and overall emotional resilience. Join us and unlock new levels of well-being, inner harmony, and rejuvenation through the transformative power of breathwork.

Your own private sauna and plunge in our garden oasis. 

We offer a cutting-edge infrared sauna experience that uses light to directly warm your body, allowing for a deeper and more detoxifying sweat at a comfortable temperature.

Additionally, we provide an invigorating ice bath experience known for its health benefits, such as improved circulation, enhanced immune response, and faster recovery from physical exertion. The cold plunge pool immersion is particularly popular among athletes for its ability to reduce inflammation and aid in muscle recovery.

Book for yourself or include up to two extra people (three in total). There is an additional charge of $25 per extra person, payable at our reception.

Pando's Recovery Room features the industry-leading Normatec boots.

These cutting-edge compression boots use dynamic air pressure to enhance blood flow, reduce muscle soreness, and accelerate recovery after intense workouts.

Perfect for athletes and fitness enthusiasts, Normatec boots mimic natural muscle pumps, flushing out lactic acid and reducing inflammation. Feel the soothing massage as the boots work through different zones of your legs, providing a relaxing and revitalising experience.

Whether you're recovering from a marathon, an intense gym session, or just a long day on your feet, Normatec boots offer unparalleled comfort and rejuvenation. Recover faster, perform better!
